app.name: FileMaster
app.tagline: Convert, compress and edit your files right in the browser.

theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark theme

upload.browse: or click to choose a file
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
upload.wrongKind: This tool does not accept {{kind}} files.

dashboard.title: Welcome to FileMaster
dashboard.subtitle: Drop a file to convert it, shrink it or trim it. Everything is processed on your own server and deleted afterwards.
dashboard.next: What would you like to do with {{name}}?
dashboard.noRecent: Nothing yet. Files you process will appear here.
dashboard.formatsNote: Only conversions that are really supported for your file are offered.

tools.convert: Change a file to another format.
tools.compress: Make a file smaller, with a quality level you choose.
tools.image: Crop, resize, rotate and flip images.
tools.audio: Cut an audio file with a waveform timeline.
tools.video: Cut a video with a visual timeline.

convert.title: Convert a file
convert.noTargets: No conversion is available for this format.
convert.docNote: Document conversions keep text and basic structure. Complex layouts, images and fonts may not be preserved. Scanned PDFs contain no text to extract.
convert.audioExtract: Choosing an audio format for a video extracts its soundtrack.

compress.title: Compress a file
compress.targetHint: Settings are adjusted to get close to this size. It cannot be guaranteed.
compress.pdfNote: PDF results depend on the content: mostly-text files shrink little, image-heavy files shrink a lot.
compress.notSupported: This format cannot be compressed. Convert it to another format first.
compress.losslessNote: WAV and FLAC are lossless: levels reduce the sample rate. Choose MP3, AAC, OGG or M4A for much smaller files.

result.title: Your file is ready
result.alreadyOptimal: This file is already well optimised, so the original was kept.
result.targetMissed: The target size could not be reached with acceptable settings. This is the smallest result.
result.noPreview: No preview is available for this format.
result.expires: Files are removed from the server after {{minutes}} minutes.

image.title: Image editor
image.customHint: Enter a width and a height to set the crop ratio.
image.resizeHint: Leave empty to keep the cropped size. The other side follows automatically.
image.drag: Drag the image to position it. Use the zoom to frame it.

editor.timeHint: Use m:ss.ms or seconds, for example 1:23.5
editor.invalidTime: Enter a start and an end inside the file duration, with the start before the end.
editor.preciseHint: On: frame-accurate, re-encodes the file. Off: instant, but the cut may snap to the nearest keyframe.
editor.dragHint: Drag the handles to choose the part to keep.
editor.waveformFailed: The waveform could not be drawn. Use Simple mode instead.
editor.noPlayback: Your browser cannot play this file, but you can still enter times and export.

recent.title: Recent files
recent.clearConfirm: Remove every entry from this list? Files you already downloaded are not affected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.preciseDefaultHint: Used as the starting choice in the audio and video editors.
settings.storageText: Uploaded and processed files live in a temporary folder on the server and are deleted automatically after {{minutes}} minutes. Nothing is stored permanently.
settings.aboutText: FileMaster converts, compresses and edits files with FFmpeg, Pillow and PyMuPDF.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.file_not_found: This file has expired or was removed. Upload it again.
errors.job_not_found: This result is no longer available.
errors.result_not_ready: The result is not ready yet.
errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported.
errors.extension_mismatch: The file extension does not match its real content.
errors.file_too_large: This file is larger than the {{max_mb}} MB limit.
errors.invalid_image: This image is damaged or unreadable.
errors.image_too_large: This image has too many pixels to process.
errors.invalid_document: This document is damaged or unreadable.
errors.invalid_media: This audio or video file is damaged or unreadable.
errors.probe_failed: The media file could not be inspected.
errors.no_video_stream: This file has no video track.
errors.no_audio_stream: This file has no audio track.
errors.no_text_in_pdf: This PDF contains no selectable text (it may be a scan).
errors.unsupported_format: This output format is not supported.
errors.compress_not_supported: This format cannot be compressed. Convert it first.
errors.target_size_needs_lossy: A target size needs a lossy format. Choose MP3, AAC, OGG or M4A.
errors.codec_incompatible: This video codec cannot be used with the chosen format.
errors.invalid_range: The selected start and end are not valid for this file.
errors.trim_not_supported: Only audio and video files can be trimmed.
errors.timeout: Processing took too long and was stopped.
errors.processing_failed: The file could not be processed. It may be damaged or use an unsupported codec.
errors.ffmpeg_missing: The media engine is not available on the server.
errors.preview_not_available: No preview is available for this format.
